fullPassage:
Resilience: Recovering from Difficult Times

Teenage life on social media might seem fun and easy, but being a real teenager presents its own set of challenges, both big and small. So why can some people handle tough times and become stronger while others remain unchanged and helpless? The answer lies in resilience — the ability to adapt to challenging experiences, such as unexpected events or personal difficulties.

The good news is that humans can recover from pressure and hardship and you can develop this skill. However, having resilience does not mean you will never feel stressed or anxious; it is perfectly normal to feel down every now and then. Resilience will not prevent problems, but it will help you face and overcome them.

Think of it like building your body's immune system. Just as you need to be exposed to germs to build immunity, you must experience difficulties to build resilience. In simple terms, resilience is not about being emotionless: Resilience means you experience. You feel. You fail. You hurt. You fall. But you keep going. It is like working out to build your muscles; it takes time and effort to enhance your resilience.

questions.passage: Teenage life on social media might seem fun and easy, but being a real teenager presents its own set of (A)[challenges / advantages], both big and small. So why can some people handle tough times and become stronger while others remain unchanged and (B)[helpless / powerful]? The answer lies in resilience — the ability to (C)[adapt / surrender] to challenging experiences, such as unexpected events or personal difficulties.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 십대의 삶은 나름의 도전(challenges)이 있고, 어떤 사람들은 무력한(helpless) 채로 남으며, 회복탄력성은 적응(adapt)하는 능력이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① challenges — helpless — adapt: 원문 그대로
❌ ② advantages(이점): challenges(도전)의 반의어
❌ ③ powerful(강력한): helpless(무력한)의 반의어
❌ ④ surrender(포기): adapt(적응)의 반의어
det.tip: challenges(도전) ↔ advantages(이점). helpless(무력한) ↔ powerful(강력한). adapt(적응) ↔ surrender(항복)

questions.passage: The good news is that humans can (A)[recover / collapse] from pressure and hardship and you can develop this skill. However, having resilience does not mean you will never feel stressed or (B)[anxious / confident]; it is perfectly normal to feel down every now and then. Resilience will not (C)[prevent / create] problems, but it will help you face and overcome them.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 인간은 압박에서 회복(recover)할 수 있고, 불안(anxious)해지는 것은 정상이며, 회복탄력성은 문제를 예방(prevent)하지는 못한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ recover — anxious — prevent: 원문 그대로
❌ ① collapse(붕괴): recover의 반의어
❌ ② confident(자신감 있는): anxious의 반의어
❌ ④ create(만들다): prevent의 반의어
det.tip: recover(회복) ↔ collapse(붕괴). anxious(불안한) ↔ confident(자신감 있는)

questions.passage: Think of it like building your body's (A)[immune / digestive] system. Just as you need to be exposed to germs to build (B)[immunity / vulnerability], you must experience difficulties to build resilience. In simple terms, resilience is not about being (C)[emotionless / emotional]: Resilience means you experience. You feel. You fail. You hurt. You fall. But you keep going.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 회복탄력성은 면역(immune) 체계를 세우는 것과 같고, 면역력(immunity)을 기르려면 세균에 노출되어야 하며, 회복탄력성은 무감각(emotionless)해지는 것이 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② immune — immunity — emotionless: 원문 그대로
❌ ① digestive(소화의): immune(면역의)와 무관
❌ ③ vulnerability(취약성): immunity(면역력)의 반의어
❌ ④ emotional(감정적인): emotionless(무감각한)의 반의어
det.tip: immune system(면역 체계). immunity(면역력) ↔ vulnerability(취약성). emotionless ↔ emotional

questions.passage: Teenage life on social media might seem fun and easy, but being a real teenager presents its own set of challenges, both big and small. So why can some people handle tough times and become ①<u>stronger</u> while others remain ②<u>unchanged</u> and helpless? questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 unexpected(예상치 못한) 사건인데 ④에 expected(예상된)로 바뀌어 부적절하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ expected: 원문은 unexpected(예상치 못한)
✅ ① stronger: 원문 일치
✅ ② unchanged: 원문 일치
✅ ③ challenging: 원문 일치
det.tip: unexpected(예상치 못한) ↔ expected(예상된)

questions.passage: The good news is that humans can recover from ①<u>pressure</u> and hardship and you can develop this skill. However, having resilience does not mean you will never feel ②<u>stressed</u> or anxious; it is perfectly ③<u>abnormal</u> to feel down every now and then. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 normal(정상적인)인데 ③에 abnormal(비정상적인)로 바뀌어 부적절하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ abnormal: 원문은 normal(정상적인)
✅ ① pressure: 원문 일치
✅ ② stressed: 원문 일치
✅ ④ face: 원문 일치
det.tip: normal(정상적인) ↔ abnormal(비정상적인)

questions.passage: Think of it like building your body's immune system. Just as you need to be ①<u>exposed</u> to germs to build immunity, you must experience ②<u>difficulties</u> to build resilience. In simple terms, resilience is not about being emotionless: Resilience means you experience. You feel. You fail. You hurt. You fall. But you keep ③<u>stopping</u>. It is like working out to build your ④<u>muscles</u>; it takes time and effort to enhance your resilience.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 going(계속 가는)인데 ③에 stopping(멈추는)으로 바뀌어 부적절하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ stopping: 원문은 going(계속 가다)
✅ ① exposed: 원문 일치
✅ ② difficulties: 원문 일치
✅ ④ muscles: 원문 일치
det.tip: keep going(계속 나아가다) ↔ keep stopping(계속 멈추다)

questions.passage: Teenage life on social media might seem fun and easy, but being a real teenager presents its own set of challenges, both big and small. So why can some people handle tough times and become stronger while others remain unchanged and helpless? The answer lies in __________ — the ability to adapt to challenging experiences, such as unexpected events or personal difficulties. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 어려운 경험에 적응하는 능력이라는 동격 설명이 바로 뒤에 나오므로, 빈칸에는 회복탄력성(resilience)이 적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② resilience: 어려운 경험에 적응하는 능력 = 회복탄력성
❌ ① intelligence(지능): 적응 능력과 다른 개념
❌ ③ confidence(자신감): 동격 설명과 불일치
❌ ④ patience(인내): 적응 능력과 다름
det.tip: resilience = the ability to adapt to challenging experiences

questions.passage: Teenage life on social media might seem fun and easy, but being a real teenager presents its own set of challenges, both big and small. The answer lies in resilience — the ability to adapt to challenging experiences. The good news is that humans can recover from pressure and hardship and you can develop this skill. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 회복탄력성은 문제를 ________하지는 못하지만, 직면하고 극복하도록 돕는다. '예방하다(prevent)'가 적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ prevent: 문제를 예방하지는 못하지만 극복을 돕는다는 대조 구조
❌ ① increase(증가시키다): 문맥상 부적절
❌ ② ignore(무시하다): but 이후 대조와 불일치
❌ ③ multiply(증가시키다): increase와 유사, 부적절
det.tip: not prevent ... but help overcome — 예방은 아니지만 극복을 돕는다는 대조

questions.passage: Think of it like building your body's immune system. Just as you need to be exposed to germs to build immunity, you must experience difficulties to build resilience. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 운동으로 근육을 키우듯, 시간과 노력을 들여 회복탄력성을 강화(enhance)한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① enhance: 시간과 노력으로 강화한다는 문맥과 일치
❌ ② diminish(줄이다): enhance의 반의어
❌ ③ abandon(포기하다): 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ restrict(제한하다): 강화가 아닌 제한
det.tip: enhance(강화하다) = strengthen, improve. working out → build muscles → enhance resilience

questions.passage: Teenage life on social media might seem fun and easy, but being a real teenager presents its own set of challenges, both big and small. So why can some people <u>handle</u> tough times and become stronger while others remain unchanged and helpless? The answer lies in resilience — the ability to adapt to challenging experiences, such as unexpected events or personal difficulties.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 handle의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: handle = 다루다, 처리하다. deal with이 동의어이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ deal with: handle과 동의어 (다루다/처리하다)
❌ ① avoid(피하다): 반의적 의미
❌ ② ignore(무시하다): 대처가 아닌 무시
❌ ④ give up(포기하다): 반대 의미
det.tip: handle = deal with = cope with = manage (다루다, 처리하다)

questions.passage: The good news is that humans can recover from pressure and <u>hardship</u> and you can develop this skill. However, having resilience does not mean you will never feel stressed or anxious; it is perfectly normal to feel down every now and then. Resilience will not prevent problems, but it will help you face and overcome them.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 hardship의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: hardship = 역경, 어려움. difficulty가 동의어이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② difficulty: hardship과 동의어 (어려움)
❌ ① comfort(안락): 반의어
❌ ③ leisure(여가): 무관한 단어
❌ ④ wealth(부): 반의적 의미
det.tip: hardship = difficulty = adversity = tribulation (역경, 고난)

questions.passage: Think of it like building your body's immune system. Just as you need to be <u>exposed</u> to germs to build immunity, you must experience difficulties to build resilience. In simple terms, resilience is not about being emotionless: Resilience means you experience. You feel. You fail. You hurt. You fall. But you keep going.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 exposed의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: exposed = 노출된. subjected(~에 노출된/처하게 된)가 동의어이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ subjected: be subjected to = be exposed to (~에 노출되다)
❌ ① protected(보호된): 반의어
❌ ② hidden(숨겨진): 반의어
❌ ③ isolated(격리된): 노출의 반대
det.tip: be exposed to = be subjected to (~에 노출되다). exposed ↔ protected/shielded

questions.passage: Teenage life on social media might seem fun and easy, but being a real teenager presents its own set of challenges, both big and small. So why can some people handle tough times and become stronger while others remain <u>unchanged</u> and helpless? The answer lies in resilience — the ability to adapt to challenging experiences, such as unexpected events or personal difficulties.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 unchanged의 의미와 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: unchanged = 변하지 않은. 반의어는 transformed(변화된)이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① transformed: unchanged(변하지 않은)의 반의어
❌ ② stable(안정된): 유의어에 가까움
❌ ③ constant(일정한): 유의어
❌ ④ fixed(고정된): 유의어
det.tip: unchanged(변하지 않은) ↔ transformed(변형된, 변화된)

questions.passage: Think of it like building your body's immune system. Just as you need to be exposed to germs to build immunity, you must experience difficulties to build resilience. In simple terms, resilience is not about being emotionless: Resilience means you experience. You feel. You fail. You hurt. You fall. But you keep going. It is like working out to build your muscles; it takes time and effort to <u>enhance</u> your resilience.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 enhance의 의미와 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: enhance = 강화하다, 높이다. 반의어는 weaken(약화시키다)이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ weaken: enhance(강화하다)의 반의어
❌ ① improve(개선하다): 유의어
❌ ② strengthen(강화하다): 유의어
❌ ④ boost(증진하다): 유의어
det.tip: enhance = improve = strengthen ↔ weaken = diminish = reduce

questions.passage: Teenage life on social media might seem fun and easy, but being a real teenager presents its own set of challenges, both big and small. So why can some people handle tough times and become stronger while others remain unchanged and helpless? The answer <u>lies</u> in resilience — the ability to adapt to challenging experiences, such as unexpected events or personal difficulties.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 lies가 이 글에서 의미하는 바와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 'The answer lies in resilience'에서 lies는 '(답이) ~에 있다/존재하다'라는 의미이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ ~에 있다: 추상적 존재를 나타내는 용법
❌ ① 거짓말하다: lie의 다른 의미
❌ ② 눕다: lie의 또 다른 의미
❌ ③ 놓여 있다: 물리적 위치가 아닌 추상적 존재
det.tip: lie in = consist in = exist in (~에 있다). The answer lies in ~ = 답은 ~에 있다

questions.stem: 다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the ability to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness"

det.korean: '어려움에서 빠르게 회복하는 능력; 강인함' = resilience(회복탄력성)
det.analysis:
✅ ② resilience: 영영풀이와 정확히 일치
❌ ① resistance(저항): 회복이 아닌 저항
❌ ③ persistence(끈기): 회복이 아닌 지속
❌ ④ relevance(관련성): 완전히 다른 의미
det.tip: resilience = 회복탄력성. resistance(저항), persistence(끈기), relevance(관련성)과 구분

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞는 형태로 바꾸시오.

"It is perfectly normal to feel down every now and then. Resilience will not prevent problems, but it will help you face and __________ (overcome) them."

det.korean: help + 목적어 + 동사원형: help you (to) overcome에서 overcome은 원형 그대로 쓴다.
det.analysis: help you (to) overcome → 동사원형 overcome 그대로
det.tip: help + O + (to) V: 동사원형 또는 to부정사 모두 가능하지만, 원형이 원문

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞는 형태로 바꾸시오.

"Just as you need to be exposed to germs to build immunity, you must experience difficulties to build __________. (resilient)"

det.korean: build 뒤에는 명사가 와야 하므로, 형용사 resilient를 명사형 resilience로 바꾼다.
det.analysis: build + 명사: build resilience (회복탄력성을 기르다). resilient(형) → resilience(명)
det.tip: resilient(형용사: 회복력 있는) → resilience(명사: 회복탄력성). 동사 build 뒤 목적어 = 명사

questions.passage: Teenage life on social media might seem fun and easy, but being a real teenager presents its own set of challenges, both big and small. So why can some people handle tough times and become stronger while others remain unchanged and helpless? The answer lies in resilience. The good news is that humans can recover from pressure and hardship and you can develop this skill. However, having resilience does not mean you will never feel stressed or anxious; it is perfectly normal to feel down every now and then.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 내용으로 볼 때, 빈칸에 가장 적절한 것은?

"Resilience is the ability to __________challenging experiences."

det.korean: 원문에서 회복탄력성은 '어려운 경험에 적응하는(adapt to) 능력'으로 정의된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ adapt to: 원문 'the ability to adapt to challenging experiences' 직접 인용
❌ ① avoid(피하다): 적응이 아닌 회피
❌ ② deny(부정하다): 문맥과 불일치
❌ ④ escape from(탈출하다): 적응과 다른 개념
det.tip: adapt to = 적응하다. 원문 정의를 그대로 활용한 문제

questions.passage: Think of it like building your body's immune system. Just as you need to be exposed to germs to build immunity, you must experience difficulties to build resilience. In simple terms, resilience is not about being emotionless: Resilience means you experience. You feel. You fail. You hurt. You fall. But you keep going. It is like working out to build your muscles; it takes time and effort to enhance your resilience.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 내용으로 볼 때, 빈칸에 가장 적절한 것은?

"Building resilience is compared to building __________ because both require exposure to challenges."

det.korean: 글에서 회복탄력성을 면역 체계(immune system) 구축에 비유하고, 세균 노출→면역력처럼 어려움 경험→회복탄력성이라고 설명한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② the immune system: 원문 'Think of it like building your body's immune system'
❌ ① social skills: 언급 없음
❌ ③ emotional control: emotionless와 관련 있으나 비유 대상이 아님
❌ ④ physical beauty: 언급 없음
det.tip: 면역 체계 비유: germs → immunity = difficulties → resilience. 대응 구조 파악
